display: Muay Thai coach at a Bangkok gym (Sukhumvit Soi 26), former Lumpinee fighter, teaching mostly foreign beginners.

signals.text: More Chinese students are joining every week and I can't say much to them beyond 'again' and 'good'.
I need a Chinese version of the class sheet and timetable. Right now it's all in English.
I only have English and Thai versions of our waiver, and I need a Chinese one for the new students.
Students send us voice messages and WeChat messages in Chinese that nobody at the gym can read. I replied 'Ok, welcome' without knowing what the message said.
I'm reorganising the timetable: 7am adult fitness, noon beginner class, evening pad work.
The gym is mostly full on weekends and nearly empty on weekday afternoons. I'd like to fill those hours.
I have eight classes a week and my body is tired. I'd like to share the teaching load.
A new student wants to 'become strong like in the movies'. I'd like a good way to set expectations for people like him.
I'm slowly saving to build a house on my family's land in Buriram. It's a long plan, about five more years.
My son starts first grade in November and I'm sorting out school uniform, shoes and books on a tight budget.

offers.text: Beginner-friendly Muay Thai classes, fitness classes and private pad work in Bangkok, taught in simple English.
Around sixty fights, including Lumpinee, before I retired at 28. I can teach real technique and fight culture.
I can build a fighter's conditioning from scratch, including running, strength and pad work plans.
First class free for friends of current students, and a welcoming 7am class.
A small gym with about forty regular students and spare capacity on weekday afternoons. It could host workshops, private groups, or content shoots.
An Instagram account with 12k followers, mostly foreigners. I could feature a partner's product or service in a fair swap.
A front desk run by Khun Noi that handles bookings in English, and three trainers who can take groups.

catchers.hypo: Hi, I'm a Chinese-speaking student in Bangkok. I'd love to translate your gym's class sheet and waiver into Chinese and answer WeChat messages, and I'd train in exchange.
catchers.can: Trade free or discounted classes for translation, and have Khun Noi coordinate bookings through that person.
catchers.confirm: Are you able to read and write Simplified Chinese and speak English well enough to talk with the front desk?

catchers.hypo: I'm a Chinese tourist visiting Bangkok for two weeks and want to try a beginner Muay Thai class. Can you teach someone with no English?
catchers.can: Book them into the noon beginner class, with Khun Noi handling the booking and me demonstrating techniques.
catchers.confirm: Is this a complete beginner who is fine learning mainly by watching and copying?

catchers.hypo: I run a small translation and localisation service. I could make Chinese materials for gyms and studios aimed at foreign customers.
catchers.can: Brief them on the timetable, class sheet and waiver, and test the output with our Chinese students.
catchers.confirm: Can you produce short, plain-language Chinese text for a fitness setting, not only formal documents?

catchers.hypo: I'm a travel or fitness creator planning a Muay Thai experience in Bangkok. I'd like to book a group session and film it.
catchers.can: Use the quiet weekday afternoons for a private group class, and feature it on our Instagram.
catchers.confirm: Would your group be 10 people or fewer, and happy to come on a weekday afternoon?

catchers.hypo: I'm a trainer looking for part-time coaching work and I speak Mandarin. Do you need cover for classes?
catchers.can: Talk with Khun Noi and the other trainers about taking the evening pad-work or beginner classes, and about fair pay.
catchers.confirm: Do you have experience coaching Muay Thai or boxing, and can you work evenings and weekends?

catchers.hypo: I run a sports physio clinic in Bangkok. Fighters and trainers often have shoulder problems, and I'd like to set up a referral with local gyms.
catchers.can: Share the clinic with our students and trainers, and send injured students to them.
catchers.confirm: Is the clinic near Sukhumvit and used to treating combat-sport injuries?

catchers.hypo: I'm a parent in Bangkok with a child starting first grade. I have spare school uniforms and books to pass on.
catchers.can: Through Khun Noi and the gym community, share with families who need school items.
catchers.confirm: Are the items in good condition and suitable for a child about six years old?

forbids.text: I won't raise prices for beginners.
I can't take unpaid weeks because the gym rent is fixed.
I'm not good at writing English, so I do much better speaking and calling.
I can't do overhead pad work for the next ten days.
I won't take on work that stops me being at the gym for scheduled classes.

projects.name: Chinese-friendly gym
projects.text: Make the gym easy for Chinese-speaking students to join: translated timetable and waiver, a way to answer WeChat enquiries, and someone to help with first-day communication.
roles_needed: Chinese-speaking assistant for front desk or WeChat

projects.name: Weekday afternoon programme
projects.text: Fill the quiet weekday afternoon hours with private group classes, workshops or visiting-creator sessions.

policy.t1: When there's a real sign of collaboration, I'll share the class timetable, the student mix, and what the gym needs to run smoothly.
policy.t2: Once trust is built and I know who you are, I'll talk about money plans, injuries and family situation.
policy.never: Medical records, and the full detail of my savings and rent arrears.
